India's Defence Minister Meets Belgian Counterpart in Delhi

India's Defence Minister Rajnath Singh met with Belgian Defence Minister Theo Francken in New Delhi. The discussions focused on strengthening defence cooperation and bilateral ties between the two nations. Singh highlighted the necessity for collaborative efforts, particularly in the context of current geopolitical and economic challenges. Francken's remarks regarding India were also noted in the coverage.
